review_contract: PDB sequence and residue numbering have been extracted from coordinates, not inferred from the filename.
Every selected hotspot has an explicit full-coordinate to PDB-residue mapping and is present in ATOM records.
Hotspots were selected after solvent-accessibility and local-chemistry review; an entire epitope window was not passed blindly.
RFantibody HLT files contain H/L chains and all six CDR REMARK labels.
Germinal templates are single-chain VH-linker-VL scFv PDBs and remain a separate geometry track.
Schema v1 intentionally represents one single-chain monomer target shared by all three adapters.
Any oligomeric target requires a future multichain manifest and an engine-specific campaign; it must not be encoded by duplicating or flattening this single-chain mapping.
